purpose: Enough context for another AI or stakeholder to understand, advise, market, or extend the product.
authorityOrder: older README / architecture / brand (often Events-era — verify)

product.name: Coffee Meetups
product.oneLiner: Pakistan-first social product for small, host-approved cafe tables — request a seat, get approved, meet IRL.
product.unitOfProduct: Table (hosted limited-seat meetup at a cafe or coordinates)
product.not: Mass open-RSVP events site, dating app, or generic Meetup clone

vision.jobToBeDone: Help young adults in Pakistan meet interesting people IRL over coffee in a safe, curated, seat-limited way.
vision.trustModel: Host approval, code of conduct, report/block, admin suspend/ban
vision.growthModel: Instagram + Featured Moments (photos/reels/collages) + company-hosted nights + community hosts
vision.monetizationNearTerm: PKR price shown in-app; Phase 1 payment collected off-platform (WhatsApp/bank) after approval
vision.monetizationNotShipped: In-app paid Table checkout / Pakistan payment gateway

needs: Convert IG → signup → request → confirmed seat

coreJourney: Email signup (OTP once → set password) or email+password login
Browse Home / Discover / Nearby / Search / Meetups / Calendar / Saved
Open Table → accept code of conduct → request to join
After start: reviews between eligible participants
Optional: connections, DMs, notifications, invite friends
businessRules: Seat capacity 2–50; host cannot join own table
Join requests start PENDING; approval claims a seat; leave releases a seat
Edit blocked after start / cancelled / completed
Chat restricted to host + approved guests
CNIC/gender-track not required to join today
SUSPENDED/BANNED accounts cannot authenticate or use APIs
Never expose OTP devCode in production; passwords are salted scrypt only

consumerValue: Safer than open IG DMs / random WhatsApp groups (approval + conduct + report)
Higher signal than large events (limited seats, vibe, cafe context)
Social proof via Moments / Featured reels

dualSupply.companyHosts: Branded nights for trust and content
dualSupply.communityHosts: Friends/creators run limited tables; platform handles discovery + requests

paymentMessaging.do: Show PKR on paid tables; say payment confirms on WhatsApp after approval
paymentMessaging.dont: Advertise in-app card checkout until it exists

gtm.funnel: Reel → bio link → signup → Discover/table → request → approve → WhatsApp pay → attend → Moments → next table

howToSell.investorNarrative: Trust-gated, seat-limited IRL social for Pakistan cafe culture, with Moments content flywheel and dual company+community host supply. Checkout and automation after unit economics in one city.

elevator.sec15: Coffee Meetups is small cafe tables in Pakistan — request a seat, hosts approve, then you meet IRL.
elevator.sec30: Anti-mass-event social layer for Lahore: limited seats, host approval, Instagram-ready Moments. Guests discover on web; company and community hosts fill nights; Phase 1 payments close on WhatsApp after approval.

identityAndAdmin: Email OTP for first password + reset; email/password thereafter
mobileWeb: Sticky bottom MobileNav for signed-in users below md

explicitNonGoalsUnlessAsked: Nationwide launch before Lahore unit economics
knownGaps: In-app Table checkout / PK payment gateway
Partial search / mutual-friend / some social UI

tech.web: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn/base-ui
tech.deploy: CI/CD only; no CLI deploy; no Prisma migrate on app startup

instructionsForReceivingAi: Treat Tables-first web as the product; do not reintroduce Events UX unless asked
Use howToSell + launch plan for GTM; use code for what works today
Ignore mobile app unless user explicitly asks
Do not invent payment gateways, WhatsApp APIs, or OTP providers — seams + TODOs only
Preserve unrelated working-tree changes; verify with pnpm --filter @jrst/web|api
docs/brand.md may still mention coral/Syne/Mapbox — verify against current web (Poppins / current tokens / MapLibre)
